# Public recognition fixtures

Downloaded 11 October 2026 for local recognition smoke tests. These are copyrighted public product images used as evaluation fixtures, not app marketing assets or user-owned clothing. Do not redistribute them as a production wardrobe catalogue.

- `public-shirt.jpg`: [Wikipedia Rabbit Hole T-shirt](https://store.wikimedia.org/products/wikipedia-rabbit-hole-t-shirt-1?variant=1321432896), image https://store.wikimedia.org/cdn/shop/files/Wiki093.jpg?v=1690473902
- `public-hoodie.jpg`: [Wikipedia Globe Hoodie](https://store.wikimedia.org/products/wikipedia-globe-hoodie), image https://store.wikimedia.org/cdn/shop/files/Wiki372.jpg?v=1690222096
- `two-garments.jpg`: controlled side-by-side collage generated from these two fixtures by `scripts/verify-multiple.ts`; not a naturally photographed wardrobe.
